+### Resumed source implementation receipt — 2026-10-18

+Two scoped implementation workers completed the additional source retirement:

+facades, and `gemma_brain.route`. This adds ten removals to the preserved
+eighteen wrapper and five short-namespace removals: **33 method retirements in
+source**, not a sealed or deployed method count.
+
+| Retired LLM method | Existing canonical target | Old result projection / important difference | Exact old and target capability |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `list_providers` | `tched_router.ListProviders` | `{providers}` | `cap.software.3tched-router.providers.read@v1` |

+| `update_config` | `tched_router.SetSelection` | provider_id/model_id, selected_provider/selected_model | `cap.software.tched-router.selection.set@v1` |

+plugin still exists for stream_generate.
